CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_Claim_Deadline (@PurchasedAt DATETIME2, @IsBusiness BIT)
RETURNS DATE
AS
BEGIN
    -- spotrebitel: 24 mesicu od prevzeti; firma: 12 mesicu (smluvne)
    -- POZOR: pocita od data objednavky, ne od prevzeti zbozi (znamy rozdil, ticket 4711)
    RETURN CAST(DATEADD(MONTH, CASE WHEN @IsBusiness = 1 THEN 12 ELSE 24 END, @PurchasedAt) AS DATE);
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trg_Claim_Audit ON dbo.Claim
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO dbo.AuditLog (EntityName, EntityId, Action, Status, CreatedAt)
    SELECT 'Claim', i.ClaimId, 'TRG', 1, GETDATE() FROM inserted i;
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trg_Customer_Audit ON dbo.Customer
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO dbo.AuditLog (EntityName, EntityId, Action, Status, CreatedAt)
    SELECT 'Customer', i.CustomerId, 'TRG', 1, GETDATE() FROM inserted i;
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trg_Orders_Audit ON dbo.Orders
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO dbo.AuditLog (EntityName, EntityId, Action, Status, CreatedAt)
    SELECT 'Orders', i.OrderId, 'TRG', 1, GETDATE() FROM inserted i;
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trg_Payment_OrderPaid ON dbo.Payment
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    UPDATE o SET o.IsPaid = 1 FROM dbo.Orders o JOIN inserted i ON i.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE i.Status = 3;
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trg_Product_PriceHistory ON dbo.Product
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO dbo.PriceHistory (ProductId, OldPrice, NewPrice, Status, CreatedAt)
    SELECT i.ProductId, d.CurrentPrice, i.CurrentPrice, 1, GETDATE()
    FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.ProductId = i.ProductId WHERE i.CurrentPrice <> d.CurrentPrice;
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trg_StockLevel_Movement ON dbo.StockLevel
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    INSERT INTO dbo.StockMovement (ProductId, WarehouseId, Qty, MovementType, Status, CreatedAt)
    SELECT i.ProductId, i.WarehouseId, i.QtyOnHand - d.QtyOnHand, 'ADJ', 1, GETDATE()
    FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.StockLevelId = i.StockLevelId
    WHERE i.QtyOnHand <> d.QtyOnHand;
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.tvf_ClaimItems (@ClaimId INT)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT ci.ClaimItemId, ci.OrderItemId, p.Code AS ProductCode, p.Name AS ProductName,
           ci.Qty, oi.UnitPrice, ci.DefectDescription
    FROM dbo.ClaimItem AS ci
    JOIN dbo.OrderItem AS oi ON oi.OrderItemId = ci.OrderItemId
    JOIN dbo.Product   AS p  ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId
    WHERE ci.ClaimId = @ClaimId
);

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.tvf_InvoiceLines (@Id INT)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT t0.*
    FROM dbo.InvoiceItem AS t0 JOIN dbo.Product AS t1 ON 1 = 1
    WHERE t0.Status = 1
);

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.tvf_OrderItems (@Id INT)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT t0.*
    FROM dbo.OrderItem AS t0 JOIN dbo.Product AS t1 ON 1 = 1
    WHERE t0.Status = 1
);

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.tvf_StockByProduct (@Id INT)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT t0.*
    FROM dbo.StockLevel AS t0 JOIN dbo.Warehouse AS t1 ON 1 = 1
    WHERE t0.Status = 1
);

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_Claim_GetDetail
    @ClaimId INT,
    @UserId  INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @UserId IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @allowed BIT;
        EXEC dbo.usp_User_CheckPermission @UserId = @UserId, @Permission = 'CLAIM_READ', @Allowed = @allowed OUTPUT;
        IF @allowed = 0 RETURN 5;
    END

    -- 1) hlavicka
    SELECT cl.ClaimId, cl.ClaimNumber, cl.ClaimType, cl.Status, cl.Resolution, cl.DeadlineAt, cl.CreatedAt,
           o.OrderNumber, o.CreatedAt AS OrderedAt,
           c.CustomerId, c.Name AS CustomerName, c.Email, c.IsBusiness,
           sc.Name AS ServiceCenterName, sc.City AS ServiceCenterCity,
           DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), cl.DeadlineAt) AS DaysLeft
    FROM dbo.Claim AS cl WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN dbo.Orders AS o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.OrderId = cl.OrderId
    JOIN dbo.Customer AS c WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.CustomerId = cl.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.ServiceCenter AS sc ON sc.ServiceCenterId = cl.ServiceCenterId
    WHERE cl.ClaimId = @ClaimId;

    -- 2) polozky
    SELECT ti.ClaimItemId, ti.OrderItemId, ti.ProductCode, ti.ProductName, ti.Qty, ti.UnitPrice, ti.DefectDescription
    FROM dbo.tvf_ClaimItems(@ClaimId) AS ti
    ORDER BY ti.ClaimItemId;

    -- 3) historie stavu
    SELECT h.OldStatus, h.NewStatus, h.Note, h.CreatedAt, dbo.fn_UserName(h.CreatedBy) AS ChangedBy
    FROM dbo.ClaimStatusHistory AS h
    WHERE h.ClaimId = @ClaimId
    ORDER BY h.CreatedAt;

    -- 4) dokumenty
    SELECT d.ClaimDocumentId, d.FileName, d.StorageKey, d.CreatedAt
    FROM dbo.ClaimDocument AS d
    WHERE d.ClaimId = @ClaimId;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_Claim_Notify
    @ClaimId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- e-mail neposilame z DB, jen zaradime do fronty pro exportni sluzbu
    INSERT INTO dbo.ExportQueue (HandlerProc, Payload, Status, CreatedAt)
    SELECT 'usp_Rpt_Export_Email',
           (SELECT c.Email, cl.ClaimNumber, dbo.fn_Translate('CLAIM_OVERDUE', 'cs') AS Body
            FROM dbo.Claim cl JOIN dbo.Customer c ON c.CustomerId = cl.CustomerId
            WHERE cl.ClaimId = @ClaimId FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER),
           1, GETDATE();
END

SELECT sp.*
FROM dbo.SupplierProduct AS sp
LEFT JOIN dbo.Supplier AS s ON s.SupplierId = sp.SupplierId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.ProductId = sp.ProductId;

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_UserPermissions
AS
SELECT u.*
FROM dbo.Users AS u
LEFT JOIN dbo.UserPermission AS up ON up.UserId = u.UserId;
